scope: Qwen3-4B BF16 greedy, A100 SM80; qualification of the fixed-64-query-tile unsplit FlashInfer mode with scalar FMA contraction disabled
plan_deviation: This candidate folds each row's full KV context without KV splitting. It is not the planned fixed-split-256 backend. The completed screen demonstrates sufficient server benefit to qualify this smaller implementation first.

measurements.exclusion_policy: Retain every completed normal arm. Interrupted arms remain evidence and are reported separately. No selective reruns or threshold changes.
measurements.comparison: Each cell's three engines run sequentially on the same physical GPU, alternating engine order by repeat. GPU6 and GPU7 campaigns run independently. Both original persistent holders remain alive.

gates.G1: Pass the enhanced GPU test: 8 head geometries, 20/60 pages, periodic and nonperiodic BF16 inputs, ordering/neighbours/chunks/step kind, eager versus twice-replayed two-layer graph, padding zero; normalized-input maximum difference to page path <=0.03125. A separate exploratory high-amplitude fixture exceeded the page-path difference threshold and is retained, not represented as passing.
gates.G2: Every native-after measured arm matches its own canonical for 192/192 requests; zero correctness and cross-concurrency mismatches. Compare canonical values across campaign roots as well.
gates.G3: HF correctness token matches >=11/15 for C1 and >=33/45 for higher concurrency whenever correctness is measured (repeat 0); do not substitute measured-workload HF agreement.
gates.G4: Natural C32 run-level median throughput >=1.00 times stock vLLM in this campaign and median paired throughput improvement >=5% over native v15C.
gates.G5: For every cell, median paired throughput change >=-1.3%, TPOT p50 change <=+1.5%, TPOT p99 change <=+10%.

decision: Accept only if G1-G5 all pass. Otherwise retain the default page path and publish the failure without relaxing the preregistered thresholds.
